name: ^asSchema$
reason: AI SDK schema adapter supplies the validator contract checked by hookArgs.

name: ^validate$
reason: The supplied tool schema owns validation; the twin checks its input and branches on the validation result.

name: ^extractHarnessPromptContent$
reason: Harness SDK determines supported media; the twin supplies the exact prompt and handles the SDK error.

name: ^HarnessCapabilityUnsupportedError\.isInstance$
reason: Harness SDK owns its branded error identity.

name: ^serialize$
reason: Caller supplied telemetry serializer is checked against the computed joined system content.

name: ^getSharedNatsConn$
reason: NATS connection availability comes from the connection manager; no connection means no publish.

name: ^hooks\.hasHooksFor$
reason: Injected dispatcher owns its hook index and answers an exact event lookup.

name: ^hooks\.runMutation$
reason: Injected hook dispatcher owns mutation execution; the twin checks event payloads and applies the result.

name: ^createHash$
reason: Node crypto constructs the requested standard SHA-256 hash; the twin checks algorithm and subsequent input.

name: ^createHash\("sha256"\)\.update$
reason: Node crypto consumes the exact computed byte string as UTF-8.

name: ^createHash\("sha256"\)\.update\(secret\)\.digest$
reason: Node crypto implements SHA-256; hex output is the trusted cryptographic primitive.

name: ^createHash\("sha256"\)\.update\(`\$\{taskId\}\\0\$\{text\}`\)\.digest$
reason: Node crypto implements SHA-256; the twin computes the UUID layout from its digest.

name: ^createHmac$
reason: Node crypto implements standard keyed SHA-256 with the supplied secret.

name: ^createHmac\("sha256", secret\)\.update$
reason: Node crypto consumes the exact supplied webhook body.

name: ^createHmac\("sha256", secret\)\.update\(body\)\.digest$
reason: Node crypto provides the standard HMAC digest; the twin computes the signature prefix.

name: ^optionalEnv$
reason: Environment reader supplies the operator's value; the twin validates it before using it.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: The platform clock is an explicit input; lifetime comparison is computed by the twin.

name: ^session\.applySteeringIngress$
reason: The session owns ingress admission; each batch is checked before the twin appends it.

name: ^session\.appendIngressEvents$
reason: Session persistence supplies ephemeral messages for the exact admitted events.

name: ^session\.loadRefreshedSystemPromptParts$
reason: Session prompt assembly owns persisted context; the twin checks its accumulated ephemeral messages.

name: Hash
reason: Node crypto hash state is used only through the checked algorithm, update and digest calls.

name: Hmac
reason: Node crypto HMAC state is used only through the checked key, update and digest calls.

name: ^\( await hooks \)\.runMutation$
reason: Injected hook dispatcher owns mutation execution; the twin checks event and payload and applies the answer.

name: ^getStorage\(\) \.budgets\.claimWarning$
reason: The storage adapter owns the once-per-month warning claim; the twin checks the account and handles rejection.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.budgets\.record$
reason: The storage adapter persists metered usage; the twin checks account, usage and source.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.taskUsage\.record$
reason: The storage adapter persists the task usage row; the twin checks the row and swallows failure.

name: ^live\.settle$
reason: Resolver of the promise made by pendingAdmission; the twin checks the started flag passed to it.

name: ^markAsyncAgentHandback$
reason: Persistence call on the result row; the twin checks the event id and handback state.

name: ^new BudgetExhaustedError$
reason: Error class construction with the checked refusal message; the twin rethrows what it built.

name: ^pruneMessages$
reason: AI SDK owns message pruning; the twin checks every pruning option and message list.

name: ^this\.childStop\.abort$
reason: Platform AbortController; the twin checks the abort reason.

name: ^this\.lifecycle \.emit$
reason: Injected lifecycle emitter delivers webhooks; the twin checks event name and payload and swallows rejection.
